description: This file is part of the PyTorch autograd code generation tools. It handles parsing derivatives.yaml into autograd functions, managing derivatives formulas, creating derivatives and forward derivatives, and processing differentiability information for symbolic differentiation. It includes functions for loading derivative definitions, handling cached loading, and creating derivative objects with formulas and saved variables, with particular focus on differentiability info for various native functions.

methods.name: None add_view_copy_derivatives( infos: dict[FunctionSchema, dict[str, DifferentiabilityInfo]], view_groups: list[NativeFunctionsViewGroup], )
methods.description: Adds derivatives for view copy variants by generating derivative info for view ops with shared derivatives formulas.

methods.name: DerivativeRet load_derivatives( derivatives_yaml_path: str, native_yaml_path: str, tags_yaml_path: str )
methods.description: Loads derivatives YAML files and creates a cache of differentiability information for native functions, including view copy derivatives.

methods.name: Sequence[Binding] cpp_arguments(f: NativeFunction)
methods.description: Gets the C++ arguments for a native function, optionally handling symmetry integers.

methods.name: Derivative create_derivative( f: NativeFunction, formula: str, var_names: tuple[str, ...], available_named_gradients: Sequence[str], )
methods.description: Constructs a Derivative object with the provided formula, variable names, and available gradients.

methods.name: ForwardDerivative create_forward_derivative( f: NativeFunction, formula: str, names: tuple[str, ...] )
methods.description: Creates a ForwardDerivative object based on the formula and variable names derived from a native function.

methods.name: list[ForwardDerivative] postprocess_forward_derivatives( f: NativeFunction, defn_name: str, all_arg_names: list[str], derivatives: list[Derivative], forward_derivatives: list[ForwardDerivative], args_with_derivatives: Sequence[Binding], )
methods.description: Adjusts forward derivatives formulas for element-wise or linear functions, including conjugation handling.

methods.name: bool is_forward_derivative_definition( all_arg_names: list[str], names: tuple[str, ...] )
methods.description: Determines if a derivative formula defines a forward derivative based on argument names.

methods.name: tuple[FunctionSchema,dict[str,DifferentiabilityInfo]] create_differentiability_info( defn_dict: dict[Any, Any], functions_by_signature: dict[FunctionSchema, list[NativeFunction]], functions_by_schema: dict[str, NativeFunction], op_counter: Counter[str], used_dispatch_keys: set[str], )
methods.description: Processes a derivatives.yaml entry to generate FunctionSchema and its associated DifferentiabilityInfo.

methods.name: list[int] used_gradient_indices(formula: str)
methods.description: Extracts indices used in grads expressions from a formula string.

methods.name: tuple[str,tuple[SavedAttribute,...]] saved_variables( formula: str, nctypes: list[NamedCType], var_names: tuple[str, ...], )
methods.description: Analyzes a formula to determine which variables require saving for backward computations, returning the updated formula and saved attributes.
